articles.summary: Porterville, Calif. – On Earth Day, April 22, 50 volunteers from Bank of the Sierra teamed up with nonprofit organizations Sequoia Parks Conservancy (SPC) and One Tree Planted to prepare 1,500 trees for planting this fall.
articles.title: Bank of the Sierra, Sequoia Parks Conservancy, and One Tree Planted Team Up to Plant 1,500 Trees
